summary: Frontend-only testing of 3 new features (CEO Dashboard, Partner API Platform management, Partner API Docs) plus light regression on Aviation Exchange. All requested flows pass end-to-end with data-testids matching implementation. CEO Dashboard renders all 12 documented KPIs and widgets with correct data (Revenue ₹1.4 L, 10 bookings, 5 listings, 1 auction with ₹31.5 Cr bid value, 9/20 fractional shares, Silver 1 / Gold 2 memberships, Partner summary 1/1 active). Refresh button works. Partner Management: existing partner ptr-ef9f63e9 renders with all controls; Add Partner flow creates ptr-b50a322d and returns new-key-dialog with ayk_ key + Copy button. Revoke → status='revoked', Activate → 'active', Regenerate → new ayk_ key surfaced. Partner Bookings tab shows pb-0ff21e55cf (confirmed, no action buttons). API Docs tab has Base URL + all 4 endpoints (/ping, /aircraft, /bookings incl. GET-by-id) with curl examples. /exchange public page loads Marketplace/Auction/Fractional sections.

issues: Y-axis ticks show 0-4 while all bars are 0 (existing bookings are outside 6-month window as noted); acceptable per spec but could show 'No data in window' caption for clarity
